reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling in Söderhamn, 3.8 ha polygon. Completed fellings from 2015 overlap only 3.9% (0.149 ha), so not already felled.

Two eligible site-bound fungi within 250 m, both recorded in 2021. The EN Gomphus clavatus was 17 m away (5 m uncertainty) and the VU Cortinarius aureofulvus 11 m away (25 m uncertainty). Their listed threats include lack of continuity forest, lack of large/old trees and ground disturbance from forestry. Both uncertainties are small relative to the 110 m equivalent radius.
Three site-bound forest NT fungi were also recorded within 250 m (2018 records, 104-126 m): Porodaedalea pini, Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum and Fomitopsis rosea. They are supporting evidence only.

Effort is adequate and above the county median (61 records vs 27; 66th percentile). Near-site there are 40 records of 37 species within 250 m on 7 days, and 4 records of 4 species inside the polygon on 1 day.

uncertainties: The nearest eligible records lie 11 m and 17 m from the polygon edge, so whether they are inside the stand to be felled is not established.
The eligible records are from a single year (2021) and one record each, so current occurrence is unknown.
The 2015 completed felling overlaps a small part of the polygon, and I did not check whether it affects the record locations.
not_established: Whether Gomphus clavatus or Cortinarius aureofulvus occupy the polygon today.
That the site is safe to fell.
Absence of other records does not show absence of other species.
next_action: Reviewer should locate the 2021 Gomphus clavatus and Cortinarius aureofulvus records against the polygon boundary. They should assess the habitat and consider a field survey, since fungi are seasonal and hard to detect.
